function.name: client_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates of a single client based on the client's name and the status of the mandate. Partners can use this API to retrieve mandate information for their clients. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The full name of the client whose mandates are to be fetched.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched. If not specified, mandates with all statuses are retrieved.

function.name: partner_mandates
function.description: Fetches all mandates for all clients associated with a partner, filtered by the status of the mandates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

status.description: The status of mandates to fetch. Possible values are 'active', 'pending', and 'inactive'.

function.name: partner_sips
function.description: Fetch all Systematic Investment Plans (SIPs) of all clients associated with a partner, filtered by the given status of the SIP. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

status.description: The status of the SIPs to be fetched. Valid statuses include 'active', 'stopped', and 'paused'.

message.content:
A **mandate** in the context of financial services (especially in wealth management, asset management, or investment advisory) refers to a formal instruction or authorization that a client gives to a financial professional or institution to act on their behalf. It typically outlines:

| Element | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Scope of Authority** | Specifies what the advisor can do—e.g., buy/sell securities, manage cash, rebalance portfolios, or make investment decisions. |
| **Investment Objectives** | Defines the client’s goals (growth, income, preservation of capital, etc.) and risk tolerance. |
| **Asset Allocation** | Sets target percentages for different asset classes (equities, bonds, alternatives, cash). |
| **Performance Benchmarks** | Establishes reference indices or targets against which performance will be measured. |
| **Duration** | Indicates whether the mandate is ongoing, for a fixed term, or until a specific event occurs. |
| **Fees & Compensation** | Details how the advisor will be compensated (fixed fee, performance fee, etc.). |
| **Reporting & Communication** | Outlines how often and in what format the advisor will report back to the client. |

Mandates can be **active** (currently in effect), **pending** (awaiting client approval or execution), or **inactive** (terminated or expired). They serve as a legal and operational framework that ensures both parties understand their responsibilities and expectations.
